_comment: Tunable numbers. Movement is in hundredths of a movement point (100 = one grass tile).
_difficulty: Overall level (lobby): human starting resources, monster group size, AI income and growth bonus.
_aiSlotDifficulty: Added for one AI player on top of the overall level (lobby slot setting).
_veterancy: Units gain experience in battle (per unit: killed enemy HP x xpPercent / surviving units). Stars 1..5 at the thresholds; each star adds its bonus.

battle._joinStrengthRatio: neutral monsters this many times weaker than the hero's army offer to join him (0 = never)
battle._joinCostPercent: joining costs this percent of the units' gold recruit price

_siege: Battles at a town with walls (fort = level 1, citadel = 2): wall segments with HP, towers that shoot each round, more damage for the defenders' shooters, and a catapult the attacker can pay for, for one battle.
_scouting: Scouting trait: +vision tiles and +movement percent per level. Monsters and enemy heroes on the map attack a hero within zoneOfControlRadius tiles, one tile less per levelsPerZoneStep Scouting levels (not below the minimum).

movement._comment2: The slowest unit lowers the army's daily movement a little: first step whose mapSpeedAtMost >= slowest map speed applies.
